explication: TheRock is ROCm’s integrated build and release system. Contributors fetch component sources, configure the CMake super-project, and build selected ROCm subsystems. Release automation then stages artifacts through backend-agnostic storage, packages ROCm, and produces PyTorch/JAX distributions. The README also documents multi-architecture, Linux/Windows, and nightly-release support. The graph emphasizes documented product stages and sampled orchestration; several CI and component internals are represented only at their exact enclosing paths.
